items.note: S1.3.1 states the eight-row schedule giving y<-y+x for arbitrary scratch and the forward/inverse/forward composition to (-Y_a,X_a) with restored auxiliaries; the substeps reproduce the proof at 741-765: net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, and the three-stage composition. The wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are not given, but they are not part of the lemma.

States D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, and derives it by the paper's invariant: the stored array equals the frame applied to the logical array, preserved on edges and through gates because a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate (804-825).

The statement is right: nested nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3}, only the central 3->4 edges decrease (by h), sum Wm-2N+2L, and L/N=100/539 and 101/539. The derivation has the bilinear form, terminal labels, side-wire inclusion, telescoping and orthonormal bases, but leaves out the stage decomposition A=B⊥P with Q, the gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and the per-edge residual table. Nesting is shown only for the side wire, and the ratios (from I=3v^2, c=100 or 101, N=v^3) are asserted rather than computed.

It assigns P_U to gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} to source X_a, giving endpoint difference I_m on every role and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b<W_bm. The proof steps match 1156-1171: rank of P_V-P_U equals the dimension change, the N exceptional 2P_{U_a} edges, the deficit N-2L_b, and the endpoint P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m. The shear H<-H+D on every role is made explicit in S1.4.1.2.

The kernel factorization and count follow the paper (1232-1260): weight additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd weights giving i^{±[v·x]}, Hadamard conjugation to aI+bX_v, empty basis for zero residuals, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c. The second half of the proof (1273-1314) is only stated in S1.5.1.5, which names the Z signs, i^{27f} and the bank negation without the derivation: zero label gives frame I, full label gives C^{⊗m}, and the X_a->Y_a pair gives C^{-1} on 27 coordinates, fixed by C=iZC^{-1}Z.

It gives the exact deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500, both above 20·2^{-50}. Then log m<20 gives m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, as at 1319-1344. L<N/2 is supplied by S1.3.3.7.

S1.1 lists the four elementary O(V) operations. S1.2 states the controlled update y<-y+a(controls) mod Q with the b^{O(1)} offset condition, rational unit scaling, and the split at Q-a with reversed merge from 576-580. Both are single infer steps with no sub-derivation.

It states A=E_1ΠE_2 and the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V). The derivation follows the paper: elimination from the topmost row and rightmost pivot, lower-triangular transforms in descending physical order via controlled shifts, and each one of Π done by D_j<-D_j+H_i, one interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j.

Every step of 1491-1588 is reproduced: cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Φ_M frames giving H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum case analysis, and the fixed-tape parking schedule costing O(V) per node.

It states the O(Vu^tau) interchange on [P]x[2^u]x[G]x[2^u]x[B]. The route matches 1649-1734: borrow rho=O(log e) high digits as rows of range q^{2rho}>=W^k, pad rows, split the width in base m with a geometric sum (a_j<m, m^k<me), and pad [2^u] to [q^e]. The unequal-width variant (1740-1762) appears only later, in S3.2.3.

Follows 1835-1940: one kernel per residual basis vector, conjugation by P_M with only invertibility needed, the inverse-child identity with Z and (-i)^f, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions each XORing two whole slots, exactly s_c children, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D.

The derivation tracks 2013-2207: eight parity-controlled updates, packed cyclic shifts that agree with T_0 when guards are in [10,2^{K-1}-11], the union bound 80(f-1)2^{-K}, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting B, and repair by extraction and radix sort. The statement gives only the asymptotic bound and omits the hypotheses A_rect=O(p) and f<=d<=p (2007-2010) and the explicit bound. The separate final XOR at j_{f-1} (2187-2193) is not mentioned.

It states F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^{1/2}, and derives it as at 2306-2445: rows from q_0=O(log d) chunks, whole rows per role giving V/W children, internal costs O(e^lambda) by a geometric sum, leaves O(e^sigma d^{(1-sigma)/2}), and the sum over base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}).

It states the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer with error <√2 2^{-p} under d=Θ(p^eps), K=floor(d^c), r=2^{Θ(p/d)}. The route has phase frames, packed basis changes, the row recurrence, exact evaluation with Δ=ceil(C_0d^{20})=o(p) guard bits from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the bound 8B^2d^{12} with m^{10}<B<m^{11}, and disk preservation by unit row sums, as in 2450-2758.

The input scaling of the digits by 2^{-b-2} (4495-4498) is never mentioned, and S3.10 calls u=Φ(digits), so the role of the factor 2^{2b+4} is left unexplained.

errors.says: Every nonzero binary edge residual contains a vector of norm one, so it is nondegenerate and nonalternating and therefore has an orthonormal basis.
errors.paper: Nondegeneracy of each residual comes from the orthogonal decompositions ('Each residual is nondegenerate by the decompositions above'). The norm-one vector only shows the residual is nonalternating; a norm-one vector does not imply nondegeneracy.

errors.says: The exact counterpart for u=Φ(digits) and v is (u*v)/S^2, and scaling by 2^{2b+4}S gives 2^{2b+4}(u*v), whose Φ^{-1}-image is the integer digit convolution.
errors.paper: The arrays u,v are Φ applied to the digits scaled by 2^{-b-2} (numerators a_j2^{p-b-2}). The factor 2^{2b+4} 'reverses the two input scales'. With unscaled digits, 2^{2b+4}(u*v) would not be the integer convolution.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the scalar bank-exchange networks through frames, labels, the rational and phase interfaces, the explicit exponent tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, the interchange and layer recurrences, synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling, chirp, twist and CRT, to the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost bound. Each link carries its defining formulas and quotes. It thins in three places. The label construction asserts the edge nesting and loss ratios without the gate-label table. The complex interface's endpoint telescoping to C^{⊗m} is only stated. The final cost table is not assembled row by row, only its margins.

steps.note: It gives the eight-row schedule on three-element subsets of [100], restoring arbitrary scratch, and the three stages giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary wire restored. m is the dimension of F^{⊗3} with F of dimension 100. N=binom(100,3)^3 and the indexing a∈T^3 are not written out explicitly, so this verdict is at the generous edge.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate by linearity, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}. Intermediate frames are free and each edge costs only D_vD_u^{-1}.

Labels are nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, nested on every edge. The only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h=100. The full gate-label table is not reproduced, but the defining content is present.
For nested nondegenerate U⊂V, P_V-P_U has rank dimV-dimU. The N source edges 2P_{U_a} have rank one where the dimension change is zero.
Gives Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L = h times the number of central wires (L=Ich), and s_b=(W_bm-2N+2L_b)+N=W_bm-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 (bit) and 101/539 (complex), both below 1/2. Hence the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, so s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a, zero to identity elsewhere). Through Φ_M frames, the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1ΠE_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V). The node makes the sum of edge ranks, exactly s, recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W give F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} follows from eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, and the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining quantities: the bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with losses confined to the central 3->4 edges, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-N+2L, L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, a interchanges per rank-a edge, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weakest link is C1, which omits the explicit value N=binom(100,3)^3, and the label construction in C3 is asserted rather than tabulated.
